title: Interpret Aveva API System Metrics KPI Fields for Item Exchanges (Destination/Lane/Zone)
summary: Use the Aveva API “System Metrics” KPI view to interpret real-time item exchange performance for a selected destination/lane/zone. Read the exchange timing/count KPIs (Average Item Count Per Exchange, Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, Number of Exchanges, Number of HotBins, Number of MissSorts, Number of SurePost, Percent of Exchanges) and combine them with the Status and Zone fields to describe whether the lane/zone is active, bypassed, or not tracking.
when_to_use: When you need to quickly interpret real-time item exchange KPIs per destination/lane/zone from the Aveva API System Metrics KPI view, including exchange timing/counts and whether the lane/zone is active, bypassed, or not tracking.
not_for: Do not use this procedure as a substitute for verifying the correct KPI page configuration/permissions when required KPI fields (Status/Zone/Percent of Exchanges/Median/Last) are missing or unclear.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Open the Aveva API System Metrics KPI view and read the KPI fields (timing/count/quality) plus Status and Zone for the selected destination/lane context; summarize what the KPIs indicate about exchange performance and tracking state.
access_or_tools_needed: Access to the Aveva API System Metrics KPI page (HMI screen labeled as System Metrics / Aveva API page)

access_required: Aveva API System Metrics KPI page access

visual_references.description: System Metrics Aveva API page frame showing KPI field labels (Average Item Count Per Exchange, Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, Number of Exchanges, Number of HotBins, Number of MissSorts, Number of SurePost, Percent of Exchanges, Status, Zone) and the lane/destination context.

steps.title: Open the Aveva API System Metrics KPI view (System Metrics / Aveva API page)
steps.purpose: Get to the real-time KPI page where item exchange performance is shown per destination with lane, status, and zone context.
steps.instruction: Open the Aveva API “System Metrics” KPI page (the HMI screen labeled as the System Metrics / Aveva API page) that shows real-time KPIs for item exchanges.
steps.expected_result: The System Metrics KPI view is visible and shows KPI field labels/values for item exchanges, including Average Item Count Per Exchange, Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, Percent of Exchanges, Status, and Zone.
steps.healthy_condition: The KPI view is populated with real-time KPI fields (not blank) and includes the Status and Zone fields alongside exchange metrics.
steps.failure_condition: The KPI view does not clearly show the required KPI fields (especially Status and Zone) or the page appears misconfigured/blank.

actions.label: Open System Metrics KPI page
actions.exact_action: Open the Aveva API System Metrics page shown in the KPI view.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Status field does not clearly show active/bypassed/not tracking, stop and escalate to support to confirm the KPI page configuration/permissions.

If required KPI fields (Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, Percent of Exchanges, Status, Zone) are missing from the view, stop and escalate to support to verify the correct KPI page is being displayed.

steps.title: Read destination-level exchange timing/count KPIs (Average, Median, Last, Percent)
steps.purpose: Capture the exchange performance indicators that describe how exchanges are performing in real time for the selected destination row/section.
steps.instruction: For the destination row/section you are viewing, locate and note these KPI fields: Average Item Count Per Exchange, Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, and Percent of Exchanges.
steps.expected_result: You can state the current values shown on the KPI view for Average Item Count Per Exchange, Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, and Percent of Exchanges for the selected destination.
steps.healthy_condition: All four timing/count KPIs are present and show numeric values for the currently displayed destination context.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of these KPI fields are missing from the view for the selected destination context.

actions.label: Locate KPI fields
actions.exact_action: Locate and note these KPI fields: Average Item Count Per Exchange, Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, and Percent of Exchanges.

stop_or_escalate_if: If required KPI fields (Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, Percent of Exchanges) are missing from the view, stop and escalate to support to verify the correct KPI page is being displayed.

steps.title: Read lane context fields (lane name and lane system)
steps.purpose: Tie the destination exchange KPIs to the specific lane context shown on the KPI view.
steps.instruction: On the same System Metrics KPI view, locate the lane context fields and note the lane name and lane system for the currently displayed destination row/section.
steps.expected_result: You can identify the lane name and lane system shown for the selected destination context on the KPI view.
steps.healthy_condition: Lane name and lane system fields are visible and correspond to the same row/section as the timing/count KPIs.
steps.failure_condition: Lane name and/or lane system fields are not visible for the selected destination context.

actions.label: Locate lane fields
actions.exact_action: Locate the lane context fields on the same view: lane name and lane system.

steps.title: Read exchange-count and quality KPIs (Number of Exchanges, HotBins, MissSorts, SurePost)
steps.purpose: Capture counts and quality-related metrics that indicate exchange volume and miss/sure-post outcomes for the selected destination/lane context.
steps.instruction: Locate and note the exchange-count and quality fields on the KPI view: Number of Exchanges, Number of HotBins, Number of MissSorts, and Number of SurePost.
steps.expected_result: You can state the current values shown for Number of Exchanges, Number of HotBins, Number of MissSorts, and Number of SurePost for the selected destination/lane context.
steps.healthy_condition: All four count/quality fields are present and show numeric values for the currently displayed destination row/section.
steps.failure_condition: One or more of these fields are missing from the view.

actions.label: Locate count/quality fields
actions.exact_action: Locate the exchange-count and quality fields: Number of Exchanges, Number of HotBins, Number of MissSorts, and Number of SurePost.

steps.title: Check Status field to determine active vs bypassed vs not tracking
steps.purpose: Determine the tracking state of the lane/zone context using the KPI view’s Status field.
steps.instruction: Check the Status field for the currently displayed destination/lane context and identify whether it indicates active, bypassed, or not tracking.
steps.expected_result: You can identify the Status value shown (active, bypassed, or not tracking) for the selected destination/lane context.
steps.healthy_condition: Status clearly indicates one of: active, bypassed, or not tracking.
steps.failure_condition: Status does not clearly indicate active/bypassed/not tracking.

actions.label: Read Status value
actions.exact_action: Check the Status field and identify whether it indicates active, bypassed, or not tracking.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the Status field does not clearly show active/bypassed/not tracking, stop and escalate to support to confirm the KPI page configuration/permissions.

steps.title: Check Zone field and note which zone number(s) are shown
steps.purpose: Identify the zone grouping shown for the selected destination/lane context so you can interpret the Status in the correct zone scope.
steps.instruction: Check the Zone field for the currently displayed side/zone grouping and confirm which zone number(s) are shown (the source notes multiple zones per side; e.g., 7 on one side and 4 on another).
steps.expected_result: You can state the zone number(s) shown in the Zone field for the currently displayed context.
steps.healthy_condition: Zone field shows one or more zone numbers consistent with the side/zone grouping displayed on the KPI view.
steps.failure_condition: Zone field is missing or does not show zone number(s) for the selected context.

actions.label: Read Zone value(s)
actions.exact_action: Check the Zone field for the currently displayed side/zone grouping; confirm which zone number(s) are shown.

stop_or_escalate_if: If required KPI fields (Status, Zone) are missing from the view, stop and escalate to support to verify the correct KPI page is being displayed.

steps.title: Summarize exchange performance using Status + Zone + lane context and the timing/count KPIs
steps.purpose: Convert the KPI readings into a clear diagnostic summary of what is happening for the selected destination/lane/zone (active vs bypassed vs not tracking) and how exchange performance is trending.
steps.instruction: Using the combination of Status + Zone + lane name/lane system, describe what part of the system is currently active vs bypassed vs not tracking. Then summarize the exchange performance using the timing/count KPIs you recorded (Average Item Count Per Exchange, Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, Number of Exchanges, Number of HotBins, Number of MissSorts, Number of SurePost, Percent of Exchanges).
steps.expected_result: You produce a diagnostic statement that includes: (1) the Status state (active/bypassed/not tracking), (2) the zone number(s), (3) the lane name and lane system, and (4) the key exchange performance values (average/median/last timing, counts, hot bins, miss sorts, sure post, percent of exchanges) as shown on the KPI view.
steps.healthy_condition: Your summary directly reflects the KPI values currently shown on the System Metrics KPI view for the selected destination/lane/zone context.
steps.failure_condition: Your summary cannot be completed because Status/Zone are unclear or required KPI fields are missing from the view.

actions.label: Create diagnostic summary
actions.exact_action: Use the combination of Status + Zone + lane name/lane system to describe what part of the system is currently active vs bypassed vs not tracking, and summarize the exchange performance using the timing/count KPIs.

stop_or_escalate_if: If Status/Zone are unclear or required KPI fields are missing, stop and escalate to support to confirm the KPI page configuration/permissions.

success_criteria: For the selected destination/lane/zone context, you can correctly identify the Status value as active, bypassed, or not tracking.
You can correctly report the zone number(s) shown in the Zone field for that context.

You can report the exchange performance KPIs shown on the System Metrics KPI view: Average Item Count Per Exchange, Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, Number of Exchanges, Number of HotBins, Number of MissSorts, Number of SurePost, and Percent of Exchanges.
healthy_conditions: Status clearly indicates active, bypassed, or not tracking.
Zone field shows zone number(s) for the displayed side/zone grouping.
All required KPI fields are present and populated with values on the System Metrics KPI view.
failure_conditions: Status does not clearly indicate active/bypassed/not tracking.
Required KPI fields (Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, Percent of Exchanges, Status, Zone) are missing from the view.
Zone field does not show zone number(s) for the selected context.
escalation_guidance: Escalate to support to confirm KPI page configuration/permissions if Status is unclear or if required KPI fields (Median System Generated Exchange(s), Last System Generated Exchange, Percent of Exchanges, Status, Zone) are missing from the view.
